description: Renovate only maintains the pinned dependencies of variant V3. V0 to V2 deliberately stay unpinned. Renovate runs as a workflow in secure-workflows and signs its commits itself.

packageRules.description: Deliberately call the central workflow via @main, Kyverno checks its identity including the ref.
Only update the base image by digest. The Python version stays as in V0 to V2 so that the variants remain comparable.
